metadata.title: Explainer: सेंटिनली आदिवासियों की दुनिया में दख़ल यानि मौत का फ़रमान।Sentinelese Policy Document
metadata.description:
The Anthropological Survey of India has released a policy document for the welfare of the Sentinelese tribe of Andaman Islands. Warning against engaging in any commercial activity on the North Sentinel island, the AnSI says any exploitation of the island will wipe out these tribals. The document also calls for greater study into the life of these PVTG tribals. This, they suggest, can be done using the diary entries of American missionary John Allen Chau, slain by the Senetenelese tribals.
